description: This is a Kotlin source file defining the SplashActivity class, which acts as a splash screen for an Android TV application. It displays a minimal splash for 3 seconds and then transitions to MainActivity, handling lifecycle events to prevent memory leaks.

classes.name: SplashActivity
classes.description: A lightweight activity serving as a splash screen on Android TV, displaying a themed background and transitioning to the main activity after a delay.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the splash activity, sets the layout, and schedules navigation to MainActivity after 3 seconds.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Cleans up pending callbacks to prevent memory leaks when the activity is destroyed.
